issues.description: The problem statement instructs students to mark the end of the main loop with the label `loop_end`, but the solution repository uses the label `end_loop`. The template repository does not contain the requested label (students are expected to add it). This inconsistent identifier naming for the same conceptual entity (the loop end label) will confuse students when they compare their code with the solution or the instructions — they may not recognize `end_loop` as the required `loop_end` label.
issues.suggested_fix: Align the label name across artifacts. Recommended: change the solution label from `end_loop:` to `loop_end:`, and add the label `loop_end:` at the end of the main loop in the template (where students are instructed to mark it). Alternatively, update the problem statement to request `end_loop` instead of `loop_end` — but prefer making the solution/template match the documented `loop_end` to minimize student confusion.
